lead.headline: Iran Charges $1.5-2M Per Tanker for Hormuz Transit, Israel Bombs Beirut — Two-Front Escalation Reshapes Global Risk
lead.they_say: Market consensus prices Iran-Hormuz as 'contained skirmishing' and Israel's Lebanon operation as a limited buffer zone incursion. OPEC+ adding 188k bpd is seen as the dominant supply signal.
lead.reality: Iran unilaterally imposed $1.5-2M per vessel toll on Strait of Hormuz transit — $75-100M/day extracted from global oil. Israel struck Beirut's southern suburbs (Dahiyeh) for the first time in this campaign. Two independent escalation vectors converge into a single systemic geopolitical crisis the market has not connected.
lead.thesis: The gap between 'contained skirmishing' consensus and structural change in global oil transit cost is at maximum width. Every tanker that pays the toll validates Iran's new revenue stream. Every Beirut strike widens the war geography from border to capital. Oil added $3-8/bbl structural risk premium overnight.
lead.actors: Iran (Supreme National Security Council, IRGC), Israel (IDF), Hezbollah, US (Trump, Witkoff), OPEC+, Tether
lead.invalidation_trigger: International naval coalition breaks the Hormuz toll system. Iran suspends toll under diplomatic pressure. Israel announces ceasefire with Hezbollah verified withdrawal.
paradigm_implications: Iran turns military chokepoint into sovereign revenue stream — precedent for other straits (Malacca, Bab el-Mandeb)
Israel two-front war (Gaza + Lebanon) with Iran escalation layer strains US force projection capacity
Tether acceptance for Hormuz tolls is sovereign-level crypto endorsement — geopolitical payments rail narrative
lead.capital_flow_implication: Capital floods into oil, energy equities, tanker shipping, gold, defense. Out of bonds (stagflation), airlines, consumer discretionary, and tech exposed to oil pass-through.
lead.portfolio_implication: Long WTI crude (CL/USO) — $3-8/bbl structural premium at Sunday CME open. Long tanker shipping (STNG, FRO, TNK) — rate re-pricing from Hormuz risk premium. Long gold (GLD) at $2,415+ as multi-front geopolitical hedge. Short duration bonds (TLT) — stagflation trade. Short airlines (DAL, UAL). Long defense (RTX, LMT, NOC). Fade any OPEC+ dip as entry opportunity.

stories.headline: China Extends Maritime Patrols East of Taiwan — Strategic Opportunism While US Eyes Middle East
stories.they_say: Routine patrols near Taiwan — standard pressure campaign, not a blockade.
stories.reality: Beijing extended enforcement into waters east of Taiwan for the first time with named time/place/legal basis. Classic strategic opportunism: advance maritime claims while US is locked into Middle East multi-front war. No vessel boarded yet.
paradigm_implications: China tests Taiwan's eastern approaches (critical for resupply/evacuation) while US distracted
stories.portfolio_implication: Add Asia-Pacific defense (LMT, NOC as dual-use). Gold remains core cross-theater hedge. Short TSM on any Taiwan tension escalation. Invalidate if patrol pattern not sustained for 7+ days.

stories.headline: Iran Strikes Kuwait With 7 Ballistic Missiles — OPEC Producer in War Zone
stories.they_say: Diplomatic off-ramp is open. House voted to end the war. Markets priced a ceasefire.
stories.reality: Iran struck Kuwait with 7 ballistic missiles — US ally and major OPEC producer hit directly. Hormuz remains fully blockaded. Diplomatic theater and kinetic reality moving in opposite directions.
paradigm_implications: Iran-Gulf war is no longer proxy — it's direct regional war hitting OPEC producers
Kuwait inside war zone redefines Gulf security calculus
stories.portfolio_implication: Long crude, gold, VIX as continuation of existing geopolitical positioning. The Hormuz toll amplifies this thesis.

stories.headline: Bitcoin Tests $61K — 200-Week MA Is Last Line Before Liquidation Cascade
stories.they_say: Trump won't let crypto down. Senate Clarity Act advances 15-9. Pro-crypto regulation coming.
stories.reality: BTC drops 5.5% to $61.3K. Strategy sells $2.5M — 'never sell' narrative dead. $11.5B unrealized loss. ETF outflows at record. Iran accepting Tether for Hormuz toll is a bullish narrative counterweight but short-term risk-off dominates.
paradigm_implications: MSTR leverage unwind creates self-reinforcing downtrend
Iran accepting Tether is sovereign-level utility signal for crypto as geopolitical payments rail
stories.portfolio_implication: Short BTC on any bounce above $63K. Short MSTR. Invalidate if BTC holds $65K for 48h. The USDT narrative win is a medium-term bullish counter-trend.

stories.headline: Google Signs $920M/Month AI Compute With SpaceX — IPO 2x Oversubscribed at $75B
stories.they_say: AI compute demand is insatiable. SpaceX IPO June 12 is the next big tech event.
stories.reality: SpaceX lost $4.28B on $4.69B Q1 revenue — losing $0.91 per dollar. $1.8T+ valuation prices in AI revenues that don't exist yet. Broad market risk-off (NASDAQ -4.68%) threatens IPO pop. Geopolitical risk-off compounds tech headwinds.
paradigm_implications: Hyperscaler capex arms race locks GPU demand for quarters
SpaceX losing money per dollar at $1.8T — pure narrative pricing vulnerable to risk-off rotation
stories.portfolio_implication: Caution on SPCX IPO — risk-off backdrop threatens pop. Long NVDA on structural GPU demand. Sell half before Monday close. Geopolitical shock absorbs tech liquidity.

stories.headline: Zcash Bug Researcher Now Audits Monero — XMR Systemic Trust Crisis
stories.they_say: Monero is mathematically proven and more audited than Zcash. Soundness bug impossible.
stories.reality: Zcash's Orchard pool was also battle-tested before the bug was found. Privacy coins cannot prove absence of bugs. XMR has no transparent fallback — if a bug exists, the coin is unrecoverable. The researcher's next update could drop with no warning.
paradigm_implications: Privacy coins face systemic trust crisis
No privacy coin can prove absence of cryptographic bugs
stories.portfolio_implication: Short XMR on any bounce above $120. Binary event — next researcher update is a catalyst with no timeline.
